lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Logan's Lake first. Dude's horse needs water in this heat.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Hammer's men on the ridge! Keep moving.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: The horse is down. I will finish it on foot.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Logan's Lake. Easy now. Drink, then I go see Logan.

lines.speaker: bandit
lines.text: That is the rider! Get him off that horse!

lines.speaker: bandit
lines.text: Hammer's coin says he never reaches the auction!

lines.speaker: bandit
lines.text: Shoot the horse if you cannot hit the man!

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: Well now. Somebody rode in on Inferno's quad and lived. What can I do for you, partner?

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: Certificates are the Minister's department. Minister Mike Dean, this young fella wants one.

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: Till then, wet your whistle at the saloon across the street. And mind who's watching when you pay.

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: Hold it. If this is happening, it happens proper. I'm the little fella's witness. Square up. Listen for the town bell. Nobody draws till that bell rings.

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: I said wait for the bell. Again.

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: That settles it. The map's yours, son. Fair and square, and I saw it.

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: Too slow. On your feet. Listen for the bell, and we'll do it again.

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: Here he is. Caught him holding the gate open for the bears.

lines.speaker: prisoner
lines.text: All I did was open a gate. Somebody paid me to bring them in.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Who paid you?

lines.speaker: prisoner
lines.text: Never saw a face. Coin, and an order: soften the claims before the vault locks.

lines.speaker: prisoner
lines.text: They want Fort Knox first. Watch the lake outflow, the river... the trains.

lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: Find who brought the bears, Lil Blunt. I'll keep this one where he is.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: Lil Blunt. Come in off the street. Mind the glass. This is what the river wants.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: A Sharps, Model 1874. The buffalo hunters called her the Buffalo Gun.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Falling block. One shot, then you earn the next one.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: Thirty-inch octagon barrel, double set triggers, a tang sight you can read at six hundred yards.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: Set the back trigger and the front one breaks at a whisper. Take a look. Don't take her home yet.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: three coin and she is yours, cartridges by the box. Coin, never credit.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Now the one that is not for sale. Follow me out front.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Colt Gatling Gun. Six barrels, a drum on top, a crank on the side.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Doctor Gatling's patent, built by Colt. Turn the crank and the barrels turn with it. Watch the plates.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Bolted to the porch. Not for coin, not for gold. Rich will not sell her and I will not let him.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: She stays on the post, Lil Blunt. When the river comes you will want her near the bank.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Go on. Take the crank. Short bursts. The drum is all there is.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Steady hands. Remember her when the shipment comes down.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: You found the lane. Most don't.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Rich? Inferno said you know this town.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: Iron's on the wall. Coin's the only tongue I take.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: River rises tomorrow. Something rides it down.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: Set trigger. It reaches clean across the water.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: From the high rocks you'll see the whole bend. Take the high rocks.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: Lead's sold by the box. It never comes cheap and it never comes free.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Skiff's sound, crates are sealed. She'll ride wet and ride heavy.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: That don't spend here. Bring the coin you earned.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Come back when the purse sits heavier.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: Mind the lane on the way out.

lines.speaker: utah
lines.text: Be on the overlook by first light. I'll be at the water.

lines.speaker: rich
lines.text: And bring it back empty. That's how I know it worked.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: I'll take a look. Let's hear what you've got.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Much obliged. I'll make it count.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Morning, traveler. Keep your papers dry.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Claim office is down the boardwalk, partner.

lines.speaker: oldtimer
lines.text: Take it easy. This town ain't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: oldtimer
lines.text: Mind the dust. It gets into everything.

lines.speaker: rancher
lines.text: Fine day to be on your feet, partner.

lines.speaker: rancher
lines.text: Watch the horses round the bend.

lines.speaker: dressmaker
lines.text: Morning. Mind that loose stitch on your sleeve.

lines.speaker: dressmaker
lines.text: A little dust never hurt good cloth.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.text: Well now, a new face. Welcome to town.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.text: Best keep an ear out round the saloon.

lines.speaker: bald_worker
lines.text: Good day. Plenty of work before sundown.

lines.speaker: bald_worker
lines.text: Boardwalk's solid. Boots'll last longer on it.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: There you are, dear. Stay out of trouble.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: You're welcome here, young fella.

lines.speaker: grandfather
lines.text: Easy does it, son. No need to hurry.

lines.speaker: grandfather
lines.text: Good weather. Best enjoy it while it lasts.

lines.speaker: grandmother
lines.text: Lovely to see somebody new about town.

lines.speaker: grandmother
lines.text: Rest those feet when you get the chance.

lines.speaker: youth
lines.text: Hey, partner. You come far?

lines.speaker: youth
lines.text: Stay sharp round here. Folks notice things.

lines.speaker: boy
lines.text: Hi there! Want to see how high I can jump?

lines.speaker: boy
lines.text: Watch me! I almost made it that time.

lines.speaker: braided_girl
lines.text: Hello! We're playing over here.

lines.speaker: braided_girl
lines.text: Bet you can't skip as quick as me.

lines.speaker: bob_girl
lines.text: Hi! Mind the rope, please.

lines.speaker: bob_girl
lines.text: Just one more turn, then it's your go.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Rich and Utah. I'm on it, Sheriff.

lines.speaker: inferno
lines.text: Heard that Gatling clear across town. Figured it had to be you, little man.

lines.speaker: inferno
lines.text: Come on. First whiskey's on me.

lines.speaker: inferno
lines.text: Evening, Minister.

lines.speaker: inferno
lines.text: So who put a hole in his head?

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Must've been a bird that had to get rid of the heavy load.

lines.speaker: inferno
lines.text: A bird. Sure it was.

lines.speaker: bartender
lines.text: Two whiskeys, coming right up.

lines.speaker: inferno
lines.text: To the quickest little hand in GoldMine.

lines.speaker: lil_blunt
lines.text: Cheers.

lines.speaker: inferno
lines.text: Listen, my cousin Flux needs a hand with his new kettle.

lines.speaker: inferno
lines.text: We'll lie low a little while and meet up later. Stay out of trouble.

lines_pending_second_account.speaker: minister
lines_pending_second_account.text: Lord have mercy! What in heaven's name happened out here?

lines_pending_second_account.speaker: sheriff
lines_pending_second_account.text: A fair draw, Minister. The stranger called it. The little fella was faster.

lines_pending_second_account.speaker: minister
lines_pending_second_account.text: Then somebody had better pray for that poor soul. I'll see to him.

lines_pending_second_account.speaker: sheriff
lines_pending_second_account.text: That was some fine shooting, son. Haven't seen a draw that clean in years.

lines_pending_second_account.speaker: sheriff
lines_pending_second_account.text: I could use a hand like yours. Somebody let the bears hold Fort Knox.

lines_pending_second_account.speaker: sheriff
lines_pending_second_account.text: Find out who. My prisoner in the jailhouse knows more than he's telling.

lines_pending_second_account.speaker: sheriff
lines_pending_second_account.text: But get yourself properly armed first. Go see Rich and Utah, down the side lane.

lines_pending_second_account.speaker: minister
lines_pending_second_account.text: Evening, Inferno. Just saying a few words for him.
